answer: The toll gate at the pass opens only on a stamped ticket, and the gatekeeper files every ticket by date in the ledger. A plume ticket printed at home fails the ledger: at the nebula of the gate the stamp must match the gatekeeper's own die, and a home stamp is flat and wrong. Forging a ticket means bribing the gatekeeper, faking a month of entries and paying 11,300, while the mirror ticket in the ledger is kept for ten years, so a ticket whose number was never filed is torn up at the gate.
